name: Dyranapur

related.relation: the singing thing of the same swarm

facts.text: Dyranapur is a level-59 named with 10,000 health; seven skuggande come with it.
It drains life and spreads a Black Plague that lasts nearly an hour.
Allakhazam calls it a named skuggande that looks like a huge cicada, in the waterfall room; killing it lowers Svartalfar faction and raises Arachite, Svartalfar Outcasts and Varulv.

story:
The skuggande are the shadowing things: insects of the lair with wings like smoke and bodies like polished horn, big as dogs, that hang in the dark corners of the passages and hum. In the waterfall room, where the spray of the fall catches the light of the dwarves' lanterns and the noise of the water covers every other sound, the swarm is thickest, and at its heart is Dyranapur, the queen of the swarm, a thing like a cicada as large as a horse.

She drinks. Her mouth is a hollow spike, and she drains the life from whatever she touches, so that her prey grows weaker as she grows stronger. And she leaves a sickness behind her that lasts longer than most fights: the Black Plague of the lair, in her a slow thing that can sit in the blood for most of an hour. Her song under the waterfall is the hum the dwarves of Faraheim hear in their sleep when the wind is from the east, and they wake with dry mouths.

The arachites of Spindelhalla hate her, and so do the outcast svartalfar and the varulv, because her swarm goes up through the roots at night and drinks from all three of them, and they pay for her death; the svartalfar of Aegir, who are the enemies of all three, would rather she lived, which tells you something about the svartalfar and something about the others. Her eyes are prized by casters: beady and multi-faceted, they hold a little of her drinking-power, and staves made with them steal a little life with every blow. Her legs make a good staff. The dwarves say the only part of her that is no use is her song.
legend: Dyranapur is a small-raid named: a group of seven took her in 2003. Kill the skuggande, cure the plague, and keep the healer out of her life drain range. The plague lasts almost an hour, so don't fight her right before Iarnvidiur without a cure ready. Her respawn is under two hours. The Slender Skuggande Leg staff drops for spiritmasters, runemasters and bonedancers. Killing her costs you Svartalfar faction and buys you Arachite and Varulv faction. She lives in the waterfall room with her swarm; the spray hides the skuggande on the walls, so look before you pull. A full group is plenty.

loremasterTopic.text: Queen of the skuggande, the shadowing insects, in the waterfall room. She drinks life and leaves a long sickness.

bookPage: From Thorgrim of Faraheim's notes. I asked the dwarves why the spider-folk want the waterfall bug dead and the svartalfar want it kept. A dwarf laughed and said the spider-folk hate anything that drinks from their egg-sacs, and the svartalfar love anything the spider-folk hate. Then he said, more seriously, that the bug's hum is a song, and that the svartalf priests sing the same song on the night of the dark moon, when they set a cup of blood at the edge of the hollow for the queen of the spray. He said nobody knows which of them learned it from the other. He did not seem to want to know.
